report.skip_dry: dry-run: this check only runs on a real server.

down.title: WireGuard interface is down
down.detail: Interface {iface} does not exist; devices cannot connect.

warn.title: Listening port differs from the setting
warn.fix: Re-apply the configuration from the Server tab; if that does not help, run sudo systemctl restart wg-quick@{iface}

ok.title: Peer count in the kernel is correct

detail.one: {n} active device is defined in the kernel.
detail.other: {n} active devices are defined in the kernel.

warn.title: Peer count in the kernel differs from what is expected
warn.fix: Re-apply the configuration from the Server tab.

ok.title: Configuration file is up to date

warn.title: Configuration file differs from what the panel generates
warn.detail: {path} may have been edited by hand; re-applying will overwrite it.
warn.fix: Re-apply the configuration from the Server tab.

fail.title: Configuration file could not be read

ok.title: Firewall rules match what is expected exactly
ok.detail: The KUT-PEERS, KUT-IN, KUT-INET and KUT-NAT chains were verified.

out_of_sync.title: Firewall rules are out of sync
out_of_sync.detail: {detail}. The panel fixes this itself within 15 s.
out_of_sync.fix: Re-apply the configuration from the Server tab.

broken.title: Firewall skeleton is broken
broken.fix: Re-apply the configuration from the Server tab; if that does not help, run sudo systemctl restart wg-quick@{iface}

ok.title: IP forwarding is on
ok.detail: Device-to-device and internet traffic can pass through the server.

off.title: IP forwarding is off
off.detail: net.ipv4.ip_forward=0: devices cannot reach each other or the internet.

off.title: IPv6 forwarding is off
off.detail: net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=0: IPv6 device-to-device and internet traffic cannot pass.
off.fix: Re-apply the configuration from the Server tab.

ok.title: Server has IPv6 connectivity
ok.detail: Devices allowed on the internet reach IPv6 through NAT66.

none.title: Server has no default IPv6 route
none.detail: IPv6 traffic from devices allowed on the internet is dropped in the tunnel (nothing leaks); IPv4 works normally.

missing.title: ufw is not installed
missing.detail: iptables is the only host firewall.

unreadable.title: ufw status could not be read

inactive.title: ufw is off
inactive.detail: ufw does not protect the server's public interface.

ok.title: ufw is on and allows the WireGuard port

closed.title: ufw is on but the WireGuard port may be closed
closed.detail: No rule found for {rule}; devices cannot connect.

fail.title: VPN network overlaps a local network
fail.fix: Pick a new network and reinstall Kut.

ok.title: VPN network does not overlap local networks
VPN subnet is in a private address range

warn.title: VPN subnet is not in a private address range
warn.detail: {net} is a public address range; traffic to public addresses may be routed into the tunnel.
warn.fix: Pick a private network (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16 or 100.64/10) and reinstall Kut.

local.title: Endpoint is a local address
local.detail: {endpoint}: no device can connect from outside.
local.fix: Change the endpoint in the Settings tab.

private.title: Endpoint is a private address
private.detail: {endpoint}: only devices on the same network can connect. On a real VPS use a public IP or a domain name.

unresolved.title: Endpoint domain name does not resolve
unresolved.detail: {endpoint}: could not be resolved from this server.

all.title: Panel listens on all interfaces
all.detail: {listen}: may be reachable from the internet.
all.fix: Bind the panel to the VPN IP: kut serve -listen {ip}:5000

loopback.title: Panel listens on this machine only
loopback.detail: {listen}: not reachable over the VPN (fine for dry-run or an SSH tunnel).

vpn.title: Panel listens inside the VPN only

other.title: Panel listens on an address outside the VPN

ok.title: Data file permissions are strict
ok.detail: Only the owner can read them (the keys are here).

warn.title: Some data files are readable by others

none.title: Kut does not connect to outside addresses
none.detail: Update check and notifications are off.

some.title: Kut connects only to these addresses
some.detail: {list}. Nothing from outside ever reaches Kut.

off.title: Automatic backup is off
off.detail: If the server breaks, devices and keys may be lost.
off.fix: Turn it on under Settings → Backup, or take regular backups with sudo kut backup.

failed.title: The last automatic backup failed
failed.fix: Check disk usage and the permissions of {dir}.

never.title: No automatic backup has run yet
never.detail: The first one runs when its time comes.

late.title: Automatic backup is overdue
late.fix: Make sure Kut is running: sudo systemctl status kut

ok.title: Automatic backup is working
ok.detail: Last backup: {time} · {dir} (copy it somewhere else too).

blocked.title: Devices with internet access cannot reach private networks

open.title: Devices with internet access can reach private networks
open.detail: The private network block is off in Settings.

info.title: No devices yet
info.detail: Add the first device from the Devices tab.

title.one: {n} device has not been seen for over 7 days
title.other: {n} devices have not been seen for over 7 days

info.fix: If unused, turn it off or delete it.

detail.one: {n} device uses this profile and cannot reach anything (only ping to the server).
detail.other: {n} devices use this profile and cannot reach anything (only ping to the server).

fail.title: The access profile of device {name} was not found
fail.detail: All access was closed to stay on the safe side.
fail.fix: Assign a valid profile to the device.

info.detail: {list}: reach only the server; ufw decides access to the server's ports. Give them a profile to open access to other devices.

free.detail: {list}: unrestricted inside the VPN (setting “Devices without a profile can reach each other” is on); ufw decides access to the server's ports.
